unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 (github.com/BSVKey/x402-paywall/issues/1): "A Nano (XNO) settle leg where the block is the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE". Argued in its own settlement-agnostic terms from the README: you run a facilitator or use the hosted one -> on Nano the caller signs a send to payTo and the gate verifies the receive on the public chain, no /settle broadcast a third party drives; X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE is the block hash; priceUsd/priceSats + a raw amount, no miner fee; the reverse-proxy path (origin + payTo) stays unchanged. Named a Nano /settle handler beside the BSV facilitator. Carried nano-invoice + ex
